statement: After git config extensions.worktreeConfig true, running git config --worktree core.hooksPath <dir> inside one linked worktree makes only that worktree use <dir>.
uncertainty: One git version (see log). Older Git versions refuse repositories with this extension.

statement: The other worktrees kept the shared hooks: main and wt-a still ran the shared pre-commit hook.
uncertainty: Without extensions.worktreeConfig, --worktree behaves like --local and would change the shared config; not exercised here.
